# slugkit

Small URL slug helpers.

## Setup

Run `npm install` once after cloning. It has no runtime dependencies; the `prepare` script fetches the shared schema and prints where it came from.

## Tests

```
npm test
```
{
  "name": "slugkit",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "description": "Small URL slug helpers",
  "main": "src/index.js",
  "license": "MIT",
  "scripts": {
    "prepare": "node scripts/fetch-schema.js",
    "test": "node --test test/*.test.js"
  }
}
function slugify(text) {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
}

function truncateSlug(slug, max) {
  if (slug.length <= max) return slug;
  return slug.slice(0, max).replace(/-$/, '');
}

module.exports = { slugify, truncateSlug };
